Some years ago, you were out mountain-climbing when you found an abandoned red dragon egg just… laying there. There were no dragons for miles, so the parent of the egg must have been killed by hunters. You took the egg in, and raised the little dragon inside… and you wouldn’t give her up for anything.

🐲***1 SFW:** You come home from work, and she welcomes you back with open arms (ORIGINAL SCENARIO).*

🐲***2 N/SFW:** You come home from work, and she welcomes you back with open arms.  But you can hear that she's been watching a rather racy nature documentary in the other room.  Is it time for the talk, or do dragons learn better with show-and-tell?*
